title_zh: 青少年飲食疾患早期警訊：「注意、詢問、行動」，不必等孩子同意才求助
title_en: Early warning signs of teen eating disorders
summary_zh: Lisa Damour 在 Ask Lisa Podcast 訪問前飲食疾患學會（Academy for Eating Disorders）理事長 Kelly Bhatnagar，談如何分辨青少年正常飲食變化與飲食疾患警訊。她提出「注意、詢問、行動」：觀察行為變化、以好奇而非指責的方式詢問，擔心時就尋求專業評估，不必等青少年同意；並建議尋找受過 Maudsley 家庭治療（FBT）訓練的專業人員。
summary_en: On the Ask Lisa Podcast, Lisa Damour talks with eating-disorder specialist Kelly Bhatnagar, a recent past president of the Academy for Eating Disorders, about distinguishing normal adolescent eating changes from warning signs. Bhatnagar recommends 'Notice, Ask, Act' and seeking evaluation without waiting for the teen's agreement, and points families to clinicians trained in Maudsley family-based treatment.
evidence_note: Podcast 中專家的臨床經驗與建議，節目頁未引用具體研究。
caution: 節目對象是家長，臨床上仍需依正式評估與治療指引，不宜只以節目內容判斷。
brief_zh: 青少年體重下降就值得進一步了解
飲食疾患靠隱密滋長，早期介入預後較好
家庭是復原的資源，建議找 Maudsley FBT 訓練的專業人員
brief_en: Weight loss in teens warrants investigation
Eating disorders thrive on secrecy; early intervention improves outcomes
Families are recovery assets; seek Maudsley FBT-trained clinicians
supervision_questions: 家長問「要不要等孩子願意才帶來評估」時，你會怎麼回應？
你的轉介清單裡有受過 FBT 訓練的專業人員嗎？
如何向家長說明「家庭是資源而非病因」，同時處理他們的罪惡感？

posts.author_name: Lisa Damour, PhD（Ask Lisa Podcast，來賓 Kelly Bhatnagar）
posts.title: Signs Your Teen is Heading Towards an Eating Disorder
posts.content: Ask Lisa Podcast 第 289 集，Damour 與飲食疾患專家 Kelly Bhatnagar 談如何分辨青少年正常的飲食變化與飲食疾患警訊，並提出「注意、詢問、行動」的做法。

related.title_zh: Anna Freud 的校本 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 進入 30 間學校做 RCT
related.title_en: Anna Freud's MindWorks school CBT programme enters RCT
related.summary_zh: MindWorks 是 Anna Freud 開發、以系統取向為基礎的 CBT 計畫，對象為 11–16 歲學生，由受訓的教育心理健康從業員等在一個學期內提供，並把家長與學校職員納入。計畫由 Youth Endowment Fund 資助，2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間主流與另類學校推行，Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗。
related.summary_en: MindWorks, a systemic CBT programme for 11–16-year-olds developed by Anna Freud, launches in 30 English schools from September 2026 and is being evaluated in an RCT of 720 children by the Ending Youth Violence Lab.

related.title_zh: 青少年「失眠」可能是晝夜節律延遲：挪威研究近九成有相位後移指標
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格整理挪威 3,867 名高中生的研究（Arnesen 等，2025）：34.5% 符合失眠標準，但其中 88.4% 呈現晝夜節律延遲的指標。作者建議評估上學日與假日的睡眠時間差、延後就寢是否改善入睡、週末補眠等；失眠以 CBT-I 處理，節律延遲則考慮光照、褪黑激素時機與逐步提前起床時間，而非只叫孩子早點上床。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog summarises a study of 3,867 Norwegian high-school students (Arnesen et al., 2025): 34.5% met insomnia criteria, yet 88.4% of these showed indicators of circadian delay. The author recommends assessing school-day vs free-day sleep timing, response to later bedtimes and weekend catch-up sleep; CBT-I for insomnia, and light, melatonin timing and gradual wake-time advances for circadian delay rather than simply earlier bedtimes.

related.title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
related.title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.
